newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT year, Q4 profits tumble.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT year, Q4 profits tumble.

text.p: Dutch paper, packaging and office products group KNP BT on Wednesday reported sharply lower fourth quarter and full year profits but said it expected an improvement in its earnings from operations in 1997.

Fourth quarter net profit from ordinary operations dived to 92 million guilders ($48.6 million) from 151 million in the fourth quarter of 1995. Over the year net profit from ordinary operations more than halved to 231 million from 545 million guilders.
Analysts had forecast full year net profit from ordinary operations of 202-245 million guilders. The range for fourth quarter net on the same basis was 62-107 million guilders.

"The various measures that have been taken and that are being developed respectively, are to lead to a structural improvement of profitability, and will already in 1997 contribute to a material improvement of the result on ordinary operations," KNP BT said in a statement with the results.
KNP BT said the state of the paper market continued to have major repercussions for its results.
"In the fourth quarter of 1996 paper prices showed only a slight rise despite healthy demand. It is not clear whether this recovery will continue in 1997," it said.

A fall in the fourth quarter operating result to 196 million guilders from 247 million in the year earlier period was the result of poor conditions in the paper market, it said. ($ = 1.893 Dutch Guilders)
